description: Defines a 'FavoritesPanel' UI component using LightningJS framework. It renders a list of favorite items, with functionality to open details, toggle favorites, and close the panel.

classes.name: FavoritesPanel
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the favorites panel UI, including list rendering and interaction methods.

methods.name: $closePanel
methods.description: Emits a 'close' event to toggle the visibility of the favorites panel.

methods.name: $openOne
methods.description: Emits an 'openDetail' event with the ID of the selected favorite item.

methods.name: $toggleOne
methods.description: Emits a 'toggleFavorite' event with the ID of the selected favorite item.
